passages.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “O son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says to the land of Israel: ‘The end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He gave me a message.
He called me “son of man.”
The Lord GOD spoke about the land of Israel.
He said, “The end has come.
The end has come to the whole land.
It has reached all four corners of the land.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֗ם כֹּה־ אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה לְאַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל קֵ֑ץ בָּ֣א הַקֵּ֔ץ עַל־ אַרְבַּעַת כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The end is now upon you, and I will unleash My anger against you. I will judge you according to your ways and repay you for all your abominations.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the land of Israel.
God says the end has come upon you.
God will send His anger against you.
God will judge you by your actions.
God will punish you for all your abominations.
passages.original: עַתָּה֙ הַקֵּ֣ץ עָלַ֔יִךְ וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֤י אַפִּי֙ בָּ֔ךְ וּשְׁפַטְתִּ֖יךְ כִּדְרָכָ֑יִךְ וְנָתַתִּ֣י עָלַ֔יִךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבֹתָֽיִךְ׃

passages.text: I will not look on you with pity, nor will I spare you, but I will punish you for your ways and for the abominations among you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord speaks to the people of Israel.
He says, “I will not look on you with pity.
I will not spare you.
I will punish you for your ways.
I will bring your abominations upon you.
You will know that I am the LORD.”
passages.original: וְלֹא־ תָח֥וֹס עֵינִ֛י עָלַ֖יִךְ וְלֹ֣א אֶחְמ֑וֹל כִּ֣י דְרָכַ֜יִךְ עָלַ֣יִךְ אֶתֵּ֗ן וְתוֹעֲבוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ בְּתוֹכֵ֣ךְ תִּֽהְיֶ֔יןָ וִידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Disaster! An unprecedented disaster — behold, it is coming!
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He says, “Disaster is coming.
A single disaster will come.
This disaster is unlike any before.
Behold, it is coming.”
passages.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה רָעָ֛ה אַחַ֥ת רָעָ֖ה הִנֵּ֥ה בָאָֽה׃

passages.text: The end has come! The end has come! It has roused itself against you. Behold, it has come!
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God announces a warning.
The end has come.
The end has truly come.
The end rises up against you.
Look, the end has arrived.
passages.original: קֵ֣ץ בָּ֔א בָּ֥א הַקֵּ֖ץ הֵקִ֣יץ אֵלָ֑יִךְ הִנֵּ֖ה בָּאָֽה׃

passages.text: Doom has come to you, O inhabitants of the land. The time has come; the day is near; there is panic on the mountains instead of shouts of joy.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the people who live in the land.
Doom has come to you.
The time has come.
The day is near.
There is panic on the mountains.
There are no shouts of joy.
passages.original: בָּ֧אָה הַצְּפִירָ֛ה אֵלֶ֖יךָ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֑רֶץ בָּ֣א הָעֵ֗ת קָר֛וֹב הַיּ֥וֹם מְהוּמָ֖ה וְלֹא־ הֵ֥ד הָרִֽים׃

passages.text: Very soon I will pour out My wrath upon you and vent My anger against you; I will judge you according to your ways and repay you for all your abominations.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of the land.
God will act very soon.
God will pour out His wrath on you.
God will show His anger against you.
God will judge you by your actions.
God will repay you for all your abominations.
passages.original: עַתָּ֣ה מִקָּר֗וֹב אֶשְׁפּ֤וֹךְ חֲמָתִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וְכִלֵּיתִ֤י אַפִּי֙ בָּ֔ךְ וּשְׁפַטְתִּ֖יךְ כִּדְרָכָ֑יִךְ וְנָתַתִּ֣י עָלַ֔יִךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבוֹתָֽיִךְ׃

passages.text: I will not look on you with pity, nor will I spare you, but I will punish you for your ways and for the abominations among you. Then you will know that it is I, the LORD, who strikes the blow.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of the land.
God says, "I will not look on you with pity.
I will not spare you.
I will punish you for your ways.
I will punish you for the abominations among you.
You will know that I am the LORD.
I am the one who strikes the blow."
passages.original: וְלֹא־ תָח֥וֹס עֵינִ֖י וְלֹ֣א אֶחְמ֑וֹל כִּדְרָכַ֜יִךְ עָלַ֣יִךְ אֶתֵּ֗ן וְתוֹעֲבוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ בְּתוֹכֵ֣ךְ תִּֽהְיֶ֔יןָ וִֽידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מַכֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Behold, the day is here! It has come! Doom has gone out, the rod has budded, arrogance has bloomed.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God warns them about coming judgment.
The day of judgment is here.
The day has arrived.
Doom has gone out.
The rod has budded.
Arrogance has bloomed.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֥ה הַיּ֖וֹם הִנֵּ֣ה בָאָ֑ה יָֽצְאָה֙ הַצְּפִרָ֔ה צָ֚ץ הַמַּטֶּ֔ה פָּרַ֖ח הַזָּדֽוֹן׃

passages.text: Their violence has grown into a rod to punish their wickedness. None of them will remain: none of their multitude, none of their wealth, and nothing of value.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
The people have acted with violence.
Their violence has become a rod.
This rod will punish their wickedness.
No one among them will remain.
None of their multitude will remain.
None of their wealth will remain.
Nothing of value will remain among them.
passages.original: הֶחָמָ֥ס׀ קָ֖ם לְמַטֵּה־ רֶ֑שַׁע לֹא־ מֵהֶ֞ם וְלֹ֧א מֵהֲמוֹנָ֛ם וְלֹ֥א מֶהֱמֵהֶ֖ם וְלֹא־ נֹ֥הַּ בָּהֶֽם׃

passages.text: The time has come; the day has arrived. Let the buyer not rejoice and the seller not mourn, for wrath is upon the whole multitude.
passages.sermon:
God is bringing judgment on the people.
The time has come.
The day has arrived.
The buyer must not rejoice.
The seller must not mourn.
God’s wrath is upon the whole multitude.
passages.original: בָּ֤א הָעֵת֙ הִגִּ֣יעַ הַיּ֔וֹם הַקּוֹנֶה֙ אַל־ יִשְׂמָ֔ח וְהַמּוֹכֵ֖ר אַל־ יִתְאַבָּ֑ל כִּ֥י חָר֖וֹן אֶל־ כָּל־ הֲמוֹנָֽהּ׃

passages.text: The seller will surely not recover what he sold while both remain alive. For the vision concerning the whole multitude will not be revoked, and because of their iniquity, not one of them will preserve his life.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God warns them about coming judgment.
The seller will not get back what he sold.
Both the seller and the buyer will still be alive.
But the seller will not recover his property.
God has given a vision about all the people.
This vision will not change.
Every person has sinned.
No one will be able to save his own life because of his sin.
passages.original: כִּ֣י הַמּוֹכֵ֗ר אֶל־ הַמִּמְכָּר֙ לֹ֣א יָשׁ֔וּב וְע֥וֹד בַּחַיִּ֖ים חַיָּתָ֑ם כִּֽי־ חָז֤וֹן אֶל־ כָּל־ הֲמוֹנָהּ֙ לֹ֣א יָשׁ֔וּב וְאִ֧ישׁ בַּעֲוֺנ֛וֹ חַיָּת֖וֹ לֹ֥א יִתְחַזָּֽקוּ׃

passages.text: They have blown the trumpet and made everything ready, but no one goes to war, for My wrath is upon the whole multitude.
passages.sermon:
The people blew the trumpet.
They prepared everything for battle.
No one went out to fight.
God’s wrath was upon the whole multitude.
passages.original: תָּקְע֤וּ בַתָּק֙וֹעַ֙ וְהָכִ֣ין הַכֹּ֔ל וְאֵ֥ין הֹלֵ֖ךְ לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה כִּ֥י חֲרוֹנִ֖י אֶל־ כָּל־ הֲמוֹנָֽהּ׃

passages.text: The sword is outside; plague and famine are within. Those in the country will die by the sword, and those in the city will be devoured by famine and plague.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about judgment on the people.
The sword waits outside the city.
Plague and famine are inside the city.
People in the country will die by the sword.
People in the city will die from famine and plague.
passages.original: הַחֶ֣רֶב בַּח֔וּץ וְהַדֶּ֥בֶר וְהָרָעָ֖ב מִבָּ֑יִת אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּשָּׂדֶה֙ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יָמ֔וּת וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּעִ֔יר רָעָ֥ב וָדֶ֖בֶר יֹאכֲלֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: The survivors will escape and live in the mountains, moaning like doves of the valley, each for his own iniquity.
passages.sermon:
God punished the people for their sins.
Some people survived the disaster.
These survivors escaped from the city.
They went to live in the mountains.
They mourned and cried out in pain.
They sounded like doves in the valleys.
Each person mourned because of his own sin.
passages.original: וּפָֽלְטוּ֙ פְּלִ֣יטֵיהֶ֔ם וְהָי֣וּ אֶל־ הֶהָרִ֗ים כְּיוֹנֵ֧י הַגֵּאָי֛וֹת כֻּלָּ֖ם הֹמ֑וֹת אִ֖ישׁ בַּעֲוֺנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Every hand will go limp, and every knee will turn to water.
passages.sermon:
God will judge the people.
Every hand will become weak.
Every knee will lose its strength.
People will not be able to stand firm.
passages.original: כָּל־ הַיָּדַ֖יִם תִּרְפֶּ֑ינָה וְכָל־ בִּרְכַּ֖יִם תֵּלַ֥כְנָה מָּֽיִם׃

passages.text: They will put on sackcloth, and terror will overwhelm them. Shame will cover all their faces, and all their heads will be shaved.
passages.sermon:
The people will put on sackcloth.
Terror will overwhelm them.
Shame will cover every face.
Every head will be shaved.
passages.original: וְחָגְר֣וּ שַׂקִּ֔ים וְכִסְּתָ֥ה אוֹתָ֖ם פַּלָּצ֑וּת וְאֶ֤ל כָּל־ פָּנִים֙ בּוּשָׁ֔ה וּבְכָל־ רָאשֵׁיהֶ֖ם קָרְחָֽה׃

passages.text: They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will seem unclean. Their silver and gold cannot save them in the day of the wrath of the LORD. They cannot satisfy their appetites or fill their stomachs with wealth, for it became the stumbling block that brought their iniquity.
passages.sermon:
The people will throw their silver into the streets.
Their gold will become unclean to them.
Their silver and gold cannot save them.
The LORD will show His wrath on that day.
Their wealth cannot satisfy their hunger.
Their riches cannot fill their stomachs.
Their wealth became a stumbling block.
Their wealth led them into sin.
passages.original: כַּסְפָּ֞ם בַּחוּצ֣וֹת יַשְׁלִ֗יכוּ וּזְהָבָם֮ לְנִדָּ֣ה יִֽהְיֶה֒ כַּסְפָּ֨ם וּזְהָבָ֜ם לֹֽא־ יוּכַ֣ל לְהַצִּילָ֗ם בְּיוֹם֙ עֶבְרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה נַפְשָׁם֙ לֹ֣א יְשַׂבֵּ֔עוּ וּמֵעֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּ֑אוּ כִּֽי־ מִכְשׁ֥וֹל עֲוֺנָ֖ם הָיָֽה׃

passages.text: His beautiful ornaments they transformed into pride and used them to fashion their vile images and detestable idols. Therefore I will make these into something unclean for them.
passages.sermon:
The people took beautiful ornaments.
They turned these ornaments into objects of pride.
They used the ornaments to make vile images.
They made detestable idols from them.
Therefore, I will make these ornaments unclean for them.
passages.original: וּצְבִ֤י עֶדְיוֹ֙ לְגָא֣וֹן שָׂמָ֔הוּ וְצַלְמֵ֧י תוֹעֲבֹתָ֛ם שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶ֖ם עָ֣שׂוּ ב֑וֹ עַל־ כֵּ֛ן נְתַתִּ֥יו לָהֶ֖ם לְנִדָּֽה׃

passages.text: And I will hand these things over as plunder to foreigners and loot to the wicked of the earth, who will defile them.
passages.sermon:
God will give these things to foreigners.
Foreigners will take them as plunder.
God will give these things to wicked people on the earth.
Wicked people will take them as loot.
Foreigners and wicked people will defile these things.
passages.original: וּנְתַתִּ֤יו בְּיַֽד־ הַזָּרִים֙ לָבַ֔ז וּלְרִשְׁעֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ לְשָׁלָ֑ל וְחִלְּלֻהָ׃

passages.text: I will turn My face away from them, and they will defile My treasured place. Violent men will enter it, and they will defile it.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about the people of Israel.
God says, "I will turn My face away from them."
They will defile My treasured place.
Violent men will enter My treasured place.
These violent men will defile it.
passages.original: וַהֲסִבּוֹתִ֤י פָנַי֙ מֵהֶ֔ם וְחִלְּל֖וּ אֶת־ צְפוּנִ֑י וּבָאוּ־ בָ֥הּ פָּרִיצִ֖ים וְחִלְּלֽוּהָ׃פ

passages.text: Forge the chain, for the land is full of crimes of bloodshed, and the city is full of violence.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people through the prophet.
God commands, "Forge the chain."
The land is full of crimes of bloodshed.
The city is full of violence.
passages.original: עֲשֵׂ֖ה הָֽרַתּ֑וֹק כִּ֣י הָאָ֗רֶץ מָֽלְאָה֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣ט דָּמִ֔ים וְהָעִ֖יר מָלְאָ֥ה חָמָֽס׃

passages.text: So I will bring the most wicked of nations to take possession of their houses. I will end the pride of the mighty, and their holy places will be profaned.
passages.sermon:
God speaks these words.
God will act with judgment.
God will bring the most wicked nations.
These nations will take the houses of the people.
God will end the pride of the strong and mighty.
The holy places of the people will be profaned.
passages.original: וְהֵֽבֵאתִי֙ רָעֵ֣י גוֹיִ֔ם וְיָרְשׁ֖וּ אֶת־ בָּֽתֵּיהֶ֑ם וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי֙ גְּא֣וֹן עַזִּ֔ים וְנִחֲל֖וּ מְקַֽדְשֵׁיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Anguish is coming! They will seek peace, but find none.
passages.sermon:
God warned the people of Jerusalem.
He said anguish is coming.
The people will look for peace.
They will not find peace.
passages.original: קְפָ֖דָה־ בָ֑א וּבִקְשׁ֥וּ שָׁל֖וֹם וָאָֽיִן׃

passages.text: Disaster upon disaster will come, and rumor after rumor. Then they will seek a vision from a prophet, but instruction from the priests will perish, as will counsel from the elders.
passages.sermon:
God spoke through the prophet Ezekiel.
God warned the people of Judah.
Disaster will come again and again.
Rumors will spread one after another.
The people will look for a vision from a prophet.
They will not find a vision.
Instruction from the priests will disappear.
Counsel from the elders will also be lost.
passages.original: הֹוָ֤ה עַל־ הֹוָה֙ תָּב֔וֹא וּשְׁמֻעָ֥ה אֶל־ שְׁמוּעָ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֑ה וּבִקְשׁ֤וּ חָזוֹן֙ מִנָּבִ֔יא וְתוֹרָה֙ תֹּאבַ֣ד מִכֹּהֵ֔ן וְעֵצָ֖ה מִזְּקֵנִֽים׃

passages.text: The king will mourn, the prince will be clothed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. I will deal with them according to their conduct, and I will judge them by their own standards. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The king will mourn.
The prince will wear despair.
The people of the land will tremble with fear.
I am the LORD.
I will deal with them according to their actions.
I will judge them by their own standards.
Then they will know that I am the LORD.
passages.original: הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יִתְאַבָּ֗ל וְנָשִׂיא֙ יִלְבַּ֣שׁ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וִידֵ֥י עַם־ הָאָ֖רֶץ תִּבָּהַ֑לְנָה מִדַּרְכָּ֞ם אֶעֱשֶׂ֤ה אוֹתָם֙ וּבְמִשְׁפְּטֵיהֶ֣ם אֶשְׁפְּטֵ֔ם וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
